hard_rule: Never treat all DeltaT values as interchangeable.

IT_EQUIPMENT_DELTA_T.definition: server inlet / cold aisle -> server exhaust / hot aisle rise
IT_EQUIPMENT_DELTA_T.source: MAGUIRE_2011_OCP_REFLECTIONS: raised a 25F DeltaT to 35F comparing first-phase Prineville to planned Forest City. DCK 2011 interprets this as cold-aisle to hot-aisle (85F inlet implying ~120F hot aisle).

AHU_DELTA_T.note: No Forest City source equates AHU SAT-to-RAT with the 35F server rise. Fan heat, bypass, and recirculation unidentified.

EFFECTIVE_HEAT_BALANCE_DELTA_T.definition: DeltaT used in m_dot = Q / (cp DeltaT) at the facility air-stream boundary
EFFECTIVE_HEAT_BALANCE_DELTA_T.prineville_12K_prior: GENERIC_PRIOR_SCENARIO_FOR_PRN1_ONLY; must not be copied here and 19.4K must not be back-applied to Prineville

mapping_search.question: Does any public source equate 35F IT rise to facility m_dot = Q/(cp dT)?
mapping_search.hardware_generation_note: OCP v1 chassis/triplet CFM tables are Prineville-observed and server-not-facility. Forest City 2012 used OCP hardware but 35F design rise and 45% less AHU hardware are site-specific DESIGN facts, not a matched operating CFM/kW point.

air_stream_water.permitted: only as SCENARIO_ONLY if IT_EQUIPMENT_DELTA_T_DESIGN is used as if it were effective
